name: Becky L. Freeman
prior_offices: Niobrara County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official election results page)
background: Becky L. Freeman is the Niobrara County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official election results page lists her as clerk, and the official general election summary lists her with 886 votes.
